method.label: Retrospective leave-one-state-out point-error diagnostic
method.training: All other previously validity-screened states, admin-dollar weighted shares on both sides
method.gates: At least 20 valid states; positive administrative/CPS dollar totals; at least 10 raw Hispanic CPS records per valid state; pooled training and held-state shares strictly inside (0,1)
method.scoring: Admin-dollar-weighted MAE, RMSE, bias in percentage points; every residual; raw vs corrected; no CI or headline correction
method.support_summary: At least 30 raw Hispanic CPS records shown as a previously inspected descriptive subgroup only; all valid states remain scored
method.nonindependence: Sources, estimand and outcome-based administrative screen already inspected. This is a new common-rho transport test, not the adopted BV direct substitution.
method.units: States means state/DC jurisdictions. Shares of SNAP benefit dollars. QC allocates across benefit participants; CPS across SPM unit members. QC weights use its reported FYWGT*FSBEN sums, not asserted annual budget totals.

improvement_claim: Descriptive prediction errors only; no statistical significance or fiscal correction.
